cancel_list_verification.description: Stop a list that is part-way through being verified. Clearout keeps the results for the addresses it already checked and spends credits on those only; the rest are left unverified. Stopping can take up to fifteen minutes to take effect. A list that is not being verified (finished, stopped already, or never started) is reported rather than treated as a failure.
cancel_list_verification.name: cancel_list_verification

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

delete_list.description: Remove a list from Clearout for good. Its results go with it unless you keep them. This cannot be undone. Deleting costs no credits, and does not refund the ones the list spent.

find_email.description: Find someone's work email address from their name and their company. Clearout verifies each address before returning it, so anything it finds is already checked. Costs four Clearout credits, or two for a role address, and nothing when no address is found.

get_list_progress.description: See how far Clearout has got through a list. 100% means every address has been verified; Clearout then takes a few seconds more to build the results file, which 'Get verification results' waits for on its own. This is free and costs no credits.

Clearout builds that file after the last address is verified, so this waits for it rather than refusing. The link is temporary, so use it in the same run. This is free and costs no credits.

validate_name.description: Check whether a name is a real person's name. Clearout's model catches the keyboard mash, the joke and the profanity that a sign-up form collects, which no pattern match can. Costs two Clearout credits.

parameters.description: The name to check, for example Jane Doe.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: How hard to look for a keyboard mash. Lower this if real names are being turned away.

profanity.description: True when the name contains profanity.

result.description: Clearout's verdict on the name, such as 'valid' or 'invalid'.

verify_email.description: Check whether an email address is real and safe to send to. Returns Clearout's verdict (valid, invalid, catch_all or unknown) along with whether the address is disposable, free, a role address such as sales@, or gibberish, and a suggested correction when the address looks like a typo. Costs one Clearout credit, except when the verdict is unknown.
verify_email.name: verify_email

parameters.description: The address to check, for example jane@example.com.
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: How long to give Clearout before it gives up and answers 'unknown'. Leave it as it is unless somebody is waiting on the result, in which case shorten it.
parameters.name: wait_seconds

account.description: The part of the address before the @.

blacklist_info.description: Any blocklists the address or its domain is on.

bounce_type.description: How a message would bounce -- 'hard' or 'soft' -- when it would.

disposable.description: True for a throwaway address from a temporary-mail service.

domain.description: The part of the address after the @.

email_provider.description: Who runs that mail server, e.g. 'google' or 'microsoft'.

free.description: True for a free provider such as Gmail or Outlook.com, rather than a company's own domain.

gibberish.description: True when the address looks machine-generated rather than chosen by somebody.

mx_record.description: The mail server the domain receives mail on.

profile.description: Public profile information Clearout holds, if any.

result.description: Clearout's verdict: 'valid', 'invalid', 'catch_all' (the domain accepts everything, so the mailbox cannot be confirmed) or 'unknown'.

role.description: True for an address that belongs to a role rather than a person, such as sales@ or support@.

safe_to_send.description: Whether to send to it: 'yes', 'no' or 'risky'. This is the field to branch on.

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

suggested_email_address.description: A likely fix for a typo (jane@gmal.com to jane@gmail.com), or empty when Clearout has no suggestion.

time_taken.description: How long the check took, in milliseconds.
